It is strong in every bar of the piece, before and after the stretch you marked, and everything between came down with it. The two you corrected are way stronger (9.09 s) and way smaller (9.49 s). A second reading, 'hook', adds the hook's inner beats at 18.9–29.5 s that you marked on 1 November; this one, which you love, is left without them.
